text: Wash your hands with this and do not tell anyone. Prosperity will begin to flow differently in your life. What I am about to teach you is simple, but it carries a very ancient symbolism. In many traditions, the key to abundance is not outside, it is in your own hands. Salt is one of the most used elements for purification. It represents cleansing, protection, and renewal. And when it is used with intention, it helps dissolve energies of scarcity, blockage, and accumulated weight. Do this ritual whenever you feel that something is stuck, that the flow has slowed down, or that the atmosphere feels heavy. Step by step, take a glass of water and add two tablespoons of salt. Mix well and let it rest for one hour so that what is dense begins to separate. After one hour, take the glass to the sink and wash your hands with that water slowly. While you wash them, repeat in your mind. I release all energy of scarcity. I open space for prosperity. May abundance find its way to me. Feel as if everything that was weighing you down is leaving with the water. Visualize the blockages dissolving. Imagine the flow returning. When you finish, rinse your hands under running water and give thanks. Gratitude is an energetic seal. And it is very important. Do not tell anyone you did this. Silence strengthens the intention. When you do not expose it, you do not fragment your energy. While you wash your hands. Remember your hands symbolize action. And when you purify your hands, you are symbolically purifying your path. Sometimes prosperity does not flow simply because it cannot find space to enter. And it all begins when you decide to release what was blocking it. Write in the comments the date you are watching this video and come back to tell me what changed. But do it calmly, not as a test. Do it as someone who decides to turn the page. And if you feel that the blockage is not only external, but comes from within, from stress, from fears, from emotions you have been dragging without releasing, a ritual cleans the path. But what truly opens it is the inner work. Everything you need to do that work, step by step, is inside. The way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
